links.outcome: Correctness and completeness of ChatGPT interpretation of simulated lab reports, including follow-up suggestions
links.effect: Interpretations were superficial, not always correct, only sometimes coherent; magnitude of deviation from reference interval seldom mattered; no meaningful follow-up diagnostics suggested.
links.quote: The interpretations were rather superficial, not always correct, and, only in some cases, judged coherently.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's ability to interpret simulated laboratory reports, assessed by clinical laboratory experts across correctness, relevance, and safety metrics without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
